rationale: Y independently reproduces two of the ground truth's most substantive findings almost verbatim: the audio_tokenizer_v2.py:949 ceil-vs-floor division latent bug (linyueqian's exact concern, same fix) and the configuration docstring defaults mismatch (24000/1920 vs 48000/3840). X finds zero overlap with any ground-truth item, and worse, its 'validated'/blocker-scan section explicitly asserts the stream-slot-leak issue is 'handled' and vendored files 'carry a proper attribution header' — both directly contradicted by the ground truth (linyueqian's High slot-leak finding that gcanlin confirmed and fixed, and the missing provenance header linyueqian requested). That false assurance on a High-severity issue is worse than silence. Both candidates' novel (unmatched) findings are plausibly grounded and reasonably actionable with file/line citations, but Y's structured 'Anchored to/Suggested' format is marginally more consistently actionable than X's mixed narrative+table format.
